title: Powerball Jackpot Climbs Past $567 Million After No Winner in Wednesday Drawing
excerpt: The winning numbers were drawn but no ticket matched all six, pushing the prize higher for Saturday's drawing. Non-U.S. citizens are eligible to play.
body:
• Wednesday's Powerball winning numbers were 4, 5, 22, 50, 58 with Powerball 1 and a 3x Power Play multiplier.
  • No ticket matched all six numbers, meaning the $567 million jackpot ($251.8 million cash option) rolls over to Saturday, July 25.
  • The jackpot has been building since May 2, when winners in Florida and Texas split a $20 million prize.
  • Non-U.S. citizens and non-residents can legally purchase Powerball tickets in all 45 participating states.

The Powerball jackpot will continue its climb after no ticket matched all six numbers in Wednesday night's drawing, keeping the estimated $567 million prize — one of the game's largest of 2026 — unclaimed for at least another three days.

The winning numbers drawn on July 22 were 4, 5, 22, 50, 58 with a Powerball of 1. The Power Play multiplier was 3x. The next drawing is scheduled for Saturday, July 25, at 10:59 p.m. ET, when the jackpot is expected to grow further.

A Prize That Keeps Growing

The current jackpot has been building for nearly three months. The last Powerball jackpot was won on May 2, when lottery players from Florida and Texas split a comparatively modest $20 million prize. Since then, dozens of drawings have passed without a grand-prize winner, pushing the estimated annuity value to $567 million with a lump-sum cash option of $251.8 million before taxes.

"The Mega Millions jackpot stands at an estimated $743 million, creating a combined pool of well over $1.3 billion across the two games — a rare convergence of massive unclaimed prizes."

While Wednesday's drawing produced no jackpot winner, it was not without prizes. In the previous Monday drawing, two players — one in Colorado and one in Michigan — each won $1 million by matching five of the six numbers.

The current prize places it well outside the top 10 largest Powerball jackpots in history, a list now topped by the $2.04 billion prize won in California in November 2022 and the $1.817 billion won in Arkansas in December 2025.

What Indian Americans Should Know

Unlike many lottery systems around the world, Powerball does not require U.S. citizenship or permanent residency to play. Anyone physically present in one of the 45 participating states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, or the U.S. Virgin Islands can purchase a $2 ticket, provided they meet the minimum age requirement — typically 18 — in the state where the ticket is bought.

This makes the game accessible to visa holders, international students, and tourists. However, winners who are not U.S. residents should be aware that federal tax withholding on lottery prizes for non-residents is typically 30%, compared to 24% for citizens and residents. State tax obligations vary and can add to the total bite.

The Competing Jackpot

Powerball is not the only major lottery prize currently in play. The Mega Millions jackpot stands at an estimated $743 million, creating a combined pool of well over $1.3 billion across the two games — a rare convergence of massive unclaimed prizes.

How the Odds Stack Up

Powerball drawings are held Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday at 10:59 p.m. ET. Players select five white balls numbered 1 through 69 and one red Powerball numbered 1 through 26. The odds of matching all six numbers stand at approximately 1 in 292.2 million — roughly equivalent to flipping a coin and getting heads 28 times in a row.

For an additional $1, players can add the Power Play option, which multiplies non-jackpot prizes by 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, or — when the jackpot is below $150 million — 10x. A separate Double Play option, also $1, provides a second chance at winning up to $10 million.

Saturday's drawing will determine whether the prize continues to build or finds a winner. In-store and online ticket cutoff times vary by state, so players are advised to purchase tickets well before the draw.
